column4: Visit note | 2025-10-09 04:30 PM | Dr. Sharmin Akter, Obstetrics and Gynecology | Patient: Dalia Kabir, 24, female. Mrs. Kabir returns for review, reporting persistent acne, weight gain, and irregular periods. She works as a shopkeeper and noticed weight gain after starting a desk job in Faridpur. She has Bronchial asthma. She denies heavy bleeding or severe pelvic pain. On examination: BMI 31.1, BP 130/81 mmHg, pulse 70 bpm, weight 89 kg. Chest is clear and abdomen is soft. Assessment: Polycystic ovary syndrome. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to aim for 5% weight loss, exercise 150 minutes a week, and reduce sugary drinks. Follow-up in 3 months.

Visit note | 2025-10-11 03:30 PM | Dr. Sadia Islam, Dermatology | Patient: Hasan Munshi, 26, male. Mr. Munshi comes in for follow-up regarding itchy dry patches on his elbows and knees, which cause him to scratch at night and feel worse in winter. He works as a call centre agent and notes the condition has been worse since switching to a strong detergent in Kushtia. He has Bronchial asthma. He denies fever or weeping skin lesions. On examination: affected area about 5 cm across, BP 132/76 mmHg, pulse 92 bpm, weight 59 kg. Lungs clear, skin shows dry erythematous patches. Assessment: Atopic eczema. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to use a mild soap, avoid hot baths, and wear cotton clothes. Follow-up in 2 weeks.
